items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: We was paying Jack Teagarden $1,000 a week... I was getting $500, Hickenbotham $500, -- no Hick was getting $350, George was getting $500

ctx.x: Yep. We was paying Jack Teagarden $1,000 a week, rain or shine. I was getting $500, Hickenbotham $500, -- no Hick was getting $350, George was getting $500, and you know what's happened? They were getting eight and ten dollars at the door back then, everywhere. We went all out in Nebraska and everywhere. Jack Teagarden was a big man, and sometimes he didn't work for three days a week. He still made all kinds of money. And we sold a lot of magazines, too, because they printed up the whole show in that, and had it…
That's pretty far back to be getting that kind of money, but that was big people at that time, Dinah and Hickenbotham.
